bhbhtftq8b47wSELECT SUM(CNT) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM (SELECT C.* FROM ( SELECT A.ACMASTCODE, SUM(NVL(B.AMOUNT, :"SYS_B_00")) AS AMOUNT, MAX(NVL(B.BALANCE, :"SYS_B_01")) AS BALANCE, MAX(NVL(B.CSHDEBITAMT, :"SYS_B_02")) AS CSHDEBITAMT, MAX(NVL(B.CSHCREDITAMT, :"SYS_B_03")) AS CSHCREDITAMT, MAX(NVL(B.TRFDEBITAMT, :"SYS_B_04")) TRFDEBITAMT, MAX(NVL(B.TRFCREDITAMT, :"SYS_B_05")) AS TRFCREDITAMT, MAX(NVL(B.DEBITAMT, :"SYS_B_06")) AS DEBITAMT, MAX(NVL(B.CREDITAMT, :"SYS_B_07")) AS CREDITAMT, MAX(NVL(B.INTAMT, :"SYS_B_08")) AS INTAMT, MAX(NVL(B.COMMAMT, :"SYS_B_09")) AS COMMAMT, MAX(NVL(B.CHRGAMT, :"SYS_B_10")) AS CHRGAMT, MAX(NVL(B.RBTAMT, :"SYS_B_11")) RBTAMT, SUM(CASE WHEN A.AC_TYPE = B.AC_TYPE THEN :"SYS_B_12" ELSE :"SYS_B_13" END) HOVRFYRQ, SUM(CASE WHEN TRIM(A.AC_STAT) = TRIM(B.AC_STAT) THEN :"SYS_B_14" ELSE :"SYS_B_15" END) HOVRFYRQ1, SUM(CASE WHEN TRIM(A.GL_STAT) = TRIM(B.GL_STAT) THEN :"SYS_B_16" ELSE :"SYS_B_17" END ) HOVRFYRQ2, SUM(CASE WHEN A.ACMASTCODE = B.ACMASTCODE THEN :"SYS_B_18" ELSE :"SYS_B_19" END) HOVRFYRQ3 , B.HOVRFYSETUPSRNO FROM ACMAST A, HOVRFYSETUP B, HOVRFYPROC C WHERE :"SYS_B_20"=:"SYS_B_21" AND B.HOVYFYPROCSRNO=C.HOVRFYPROCSRNO AND B.HOVYFYPROCSRNO=:"SYS_B_22" AND (NVL(B.ACMASTCODE, :"SYS_B_23")>:"SYS_B_24" OR NVL(B.AC_TYPE, :"SYS_B_25")>:"SYS_B_26" OR TRIM(B.AC_STAT) IS NOT NULL OR TRIM(B.GL_STAT) IS NOT NULL ) AND (CASE WHEN NVL(B.ACMASTCODE, :"SYS_B_27")>:"SYS_B_28" AND A.ACMASTCODE=B.ACMASTCODE THEN :"SYS_B_29" WHEN NVL(B.AC_TYPE, :"SYS_B_30")>:"SYS_B_31" AND A.AC_TYPE=B.AC_TYPE THEN :"SYS_B_32" WHEN TRIM(B.AC_STAT) IS NOT NULL AND A.AC_STAT=B.AC_STAT THEN :"SYS_B_33" WHEN TRIM(B.GL_STAT) IS NOT NULL AND A.GL_STAT=B.GL_STAT THEN :"SYS_B_34" ELSE :"SYS_B_35" END )=:"SYS_B_36" GROUP BY A.ACMASTCODE, B.HOVRFYSETUPSRNO ) C WHERE HOVRFYRQ+HOVRFYRQ1+HOVRFYRQ2+HOVRFYRQ3>:"SYS_B_37" ) GROUP BY ACMASTCODE HAVING COUNT(*) >:"SYS_B_38")

c2uyxp5a4wgfvINSERT INTO GLBTMPACBK (TDATE, AC_NO, DRCR, CSH_TRN, PRTCLS, DEBIT, CREDIT, BALANCE, DOC_NO, ACMASTCODE, PASS, POST, CTRNNO, OTRNNO, VOU_NO, VOU_SRNO, OP_ID , SU_ID, RC_COUNT, FD_COUNT, CHQ_PREFIX, CASHIER_ID, CASHIER_OK, CASH_CR, CASH_DR, CSHR_EXCP, DENMTION , REF_ACNO, REF_ACMCD , CHQBOUNCE, FORBRANCH, ATBRANCH, VOU_GRNO , DD_GRNO, GOLD_REC_NO, DD_CLEAR, INTFRDT, INTTODT, AC_TYPE, RECEIPTNO, FD_RC_CNT , SHIFT_NO, PROC_SRNO, AC_CODE, TRNSCNID) SELECT A.TDATE, A.AC_NO, A.DRCR, A.CSH_TRN, A.PRTCLS, A.DEBIT, A.CREDIT, A.BALANCE, A.DOC_NO, A.ACMASTCODE, :"SYS_B_00", A.POST, A.CTRNNO, A.OTRNNO, A.VOU_NO, A.VOU_SRNO, A.OP_ID , A.SU_ID, A.RC_COUNT, A.FD_COUNT, A.CHQ_PREFIX, A.CASHIER_ID, A.CASHIER_OK, A.CASH_CR, A.CASH_DR, A.CSHR_EXCP, A.DENMTION , A.REF_ACNO, A.REF_ACMCD , A.CHQBOUNCE, A.FORBRANCH, A.ATBRANCH, A.VOU_GRNO , A.DD_GRNO, A.GOLD_REC_NO, A.DD_CLEAR, A.INTFRDT, A.INTTODT, A.AC_TYPE, A.RECEIPTNO, A.FD_RC_CNT , A.SHIFT_NO, A.PROC_SRNO, B.AC_CODE, A.TRNSCNID FROM ACBK A, ACMAST B WHERE A.ACMASTCODE=B.ACMASTCODE AND A.TDATE = :"SYS_B_01" AND ATBRANCH = :"SYS_B_02" AND NVL(A.CNCLED, :"SYS_B_03") !=:"SYS_B_04" AND A.TRN_TYPE = :"SYS_B_05" AND A.CSH_TRN!= :"SYS_B_06" AND NVL(A.SSD_QUICK, :"SYS_B_07")=:"SYS_B_08" AND NVL(A.SRCOFTRN, :"SYS_B_09") NOT IN (:"SYS_B_10", :"SYS_B_11", :"SYS_B_12") AND A.ACMASTCODE=:"SYS_B_13" ORDER BY VOU_GRNO, OTRNNO

dfz7nkcpg48xfINSERT INTO GLBTRNVALIDRES(ACMASTCODE, AC_NO, MSGCD, MSGDESCR, WARNINGMSG) SELECT :"SYS_B_00", :"SYS_B_01", :"SYS_B_02", :"SYS_B_03"||NAME||:"SYS_B_04"||ACCNT||:"SYS_B_05"||TOTODAMT, :"SYS_B_06" FROM ( SELECT A.ACCNT, A.TOTODAMT, A.GMST_CODE, B.NAME FROM ( SELECT :"SYS_B_07", :"SYS_B_08", COUNT(DISTINCT B.ACMASTCODE*:"SYS_B_09"+B.AC_NO) AS ACCNT, SUM(DECODE(NVL(B.OVERDUEAMT, :"SYS_B_10"), :"SYS_B_11", NVL(B.PEND_INST, :"SYS_B_12"), NVL(B.OVERDUEAMT, :"SYS_B_13"))) AS TOTODAMT, B.GMST_CODE FROM VIEWLNMAS B WHERE NVL(B.CLOSED, :"SYS_B_14") <> :"SYS_B_15" AND NVL(B.POST, :"SYS_B_16")= :"SYS_B_17" AND B.GMST_CODE=:"SYS_B_18" GROUP BY B.GMST_CODE HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT B.ACMASTCODE*:"SYS_B_19"+B.AC_NO)>:"SYS_B_20" ) A , BANKMAS B WHERE A.GMST_CODE=B.GMST_CODE AND NVL(A.TOTODAMT, :"SYS_B_21")>:"SYS_B_22" )

DECODE(GREATEST(NVL(ACCINT, :"SYS_B_044")+NVL(INTAFTMAT, :"SYS_B_045"), :"SYS_B_046"), :"SYS_B_047", :"SYS_B_048", NVL(ACCINT, :"SYS_B_049")+NVL(INTAFTMAT, :"SYS_B_050")) AS DEBIT, DECODE(GREATEST(NVL(ACCINT, :"SYS_B_051")+NVL(INTAFTMAT, :"SYS_B_052"), :"SYS_B_053"), :"SYS_B_054", ABS(NVL(ACCINT, :"SYS_B_055")+NVL(INTAFTMAT, :"SYS_B_056")), :"SYS_B_057") AS CREDIT, DECODE(B.AC_TYPE, :"SYS_B_058", :"SYS_B_059", DECODE(GREATEST(NVL(ACCINT, :"SYS_B_060")+NVL(INTAFTMAT, :"SYS_B_061"), :"SYS_B_062"), :"SYS_B_063", :"SYS_B_064", :"SYS_B_065")) AS DRCR, :"SYS_B_066" AS :"SYS_B_093" PRTCLS, A.BRANCHCODE AS ATBRANCH FROM INDPRO A, ACMAST B WHERE A.ENT_DATE = TO_DATE(:"SYS_B_094") AND A.TRINTACCD=B.AC_CODE AND B.ACMASTCODE=DECODE(:"SYS_B_095", :"SYS_B_096", :"SYS_B_104") < :"SYS_B_105" AND (NVL(FACCINT, :"SYS_B_106")=:"SYS_B_107" OR NVL(FAFTMATINT, :"SYS_B_108")=:"SYS_B_109") UNION ALL SELECT A.ENT_DATE AS TDATE, OTRNNO AS TRN_NO, B.ACMASTCODE, A.AC_NO, Finding 5: Soft Parse
Impact is .43 active sessions, 6.1% of total activity.
------------------------------------------------------
Soft parsing of SQL statements was consuming significant database time.

   Recommendation 1: Application Analysis
   Estimated benefit is .43 active sessions, 6.1% of total activity.
   -----------------------------------------------------------------
   Action
      Investigate application logic to keep open the frequently used cursors.
      Note that cursors are closed by both cursor close calls and session
      disconnects.

   Recommendation 2: Database Configuration
   Estimated benefit is .43 active sessions, 6.1% of total activity.
   -----------------------------------------------------------------
   Action
      Consider increasing the session cursor cache size by increasing the
      value of parameter "session_cached_cursors".
   Rationale
      The value of parameter "session_cached_cursors" was "300" during the
      analysis period.


Finding 6: Hard Parse Due to Invalidations
Impact is .25 active sessions, 3.5% of total activity.
------------------------------------------------------
Cursors were getting invalidated due to DDL operations. This resulted in
additional hard parses which were consuming significant database time.

   Recommendation 1: Application Analysis
   Estimated benefit is .25 active sessions, 3.5% of total activity.
   -----------------------------------------------------------------
   Action
      Investigate appropriateness of DDL operations.

   Symptoms That Led to the Finding:
   ---------------------------------
      Hard parsing of SQL statements was consuming significant database time.
      Impact is .5 active sessions, 6.99% of total activity.
